# Lindsey Sobrinski

> Growth and performance marketing leader with 15+ years across enterprise
> retail, B2B services, agencies, and subscription DTC. Work spans cross-channel
> paid media, SEO/AEO/GEO, lifecycle and retention, and user-journey conversion
> optimization. Budgets are allocated by incrementality and contribution margin
> rather than platform-reported ROAS. Available for fractional and advisory
> engagements.

## Service lanes

- [SEO, AEO & GEO](https://lindseysobrinski.com/seo-aeo-geo/): Organic and AI-search visibility built from a standing start, with a distinct play per engine — ChatGPT for awareness, Gemini and AI Overviews for consideration, Perplexity for research validation.
- [Paid Media Analysis & Strategy](https://lindseysobrinski.com/paid-media/): Cross-channel planning and buying across paid social, search, programmatic, video, CTV, and out-of-home (OOH), with incrementality testing and media mix modeling underneath the allocation.
- [Lifecycle Marketing & Retention](https://lindseysobrinski.com/lifecycle/): Retention, loyalty, churn, and win-back programs, plus subscription economics and cohort analysis.
- [User Journey & Conversion](https://lindseysobrinski.com/user-journey/): Journey mapping, dropoff analysis, and experimentation run with the statistical discipline to distinguish real lift from noise.

## Key articles

Measurement and incrementality (the through-line of the whole body of work):
- [Platform ROAS is grading its own homework](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/platform-roas-is-grading-its-own-homework/): why platform-reported ROAS overstates return, and what it hides.
- [Incremental ROAS: the only return number a CFO will actually trust](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/incremental-roas-the-number-a-cfo-trusts/): reported vs incremental return, and how to measure the real one.
- [Attribution, incrementality, MMM: stop asking which one is right](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/attribution-incrementality-mmm-which-one/): how the three measurement methods layer instead of compete.
- [How to run a geo holdout test without fooling yourself](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/how-to-run-a-geo-holdout-test/): a practical incrementality experiment for paid media.
- [Is branded search incremental? Run the holdout you're afraid of](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/is-branded-search-incremental/): whether branded-search spend adds incremental revenue.

Paid media and demand:
- [Demand generation vs demand capture](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/demand-generation-vs-demand-capture/): the split that decides whether a brand grows or just harvests existing demand.
- [Which channel for which level of intent](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/which-channel-for-which-level-of-intent/): matching channels to intent and sequencing them.
- [The cheap-acquisition era is ending: AI search is forcing paid back upstream](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/ai-search-is-forcing-paid-back-upstream/): why AI search raises the cost of demand and pushes paid to demand generation.
- [The model got 99% cheaper. Your CAC didn't.](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-model-got-cheaper-your-cac-didnt/): why cheaper AI lowers the cost of producing marketing, not the cost of demand.
- [Your campaigns were beating their targets. Google just ended that.](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/google-target-based-bidding-change/): Google's Aug 2026 target-based bidding change and what to reset.
- [Prospecting vs retargeting: your retargeting ROAS is mostly a mirror](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/prospecting-vs-retargeting/): why retargeting over-claims credit for demand that already existed.

SEO, AEO and GEO (AI-search visibility):
- [SXO vs SEO vs AEO vs GEO: you don't have four disciplines, you have one machine](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/sxo-vs-seo-one-machine/): why these acronyms describe one journey, not four teams.
- [The 4 P's of AI visibility](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-4-ps-of-ai-visibility/): the IAB's Presence, Prominence, Portrayal, Persuasion framework, and how the tools measuring it stack up.
- [One citation play per engine: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity don't read you the same way](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/one-citation-play-per-engine/): a distinct GEO play for each AI engine.
- [The source-of-truth gap: when Reddit knows your catalog better than the AI does](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-source-of-truth-gap/): why AI answers about a brand come from third parties, and how to close the gap.
- [Winning the answer box when the click never comes](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/winning-the-answer-box/): answer engine optimization for zero-click results.
- [Why your customers are shopping like they're choosing a surgeon](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/shopping-like-choosing-a-surgeon/): how AI research shortlists changed high-consideration buying.
- [The AI watermark is here. It measures the wrong thing.](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-ai-watermark-measures-the-wrong-thing/): why AI-content watermarks don't threaten SEO and what the real risk is.

Technical SEO:
- [Your JavaScript site is invisible to AI crawlers](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/your-javascript-site-is-invisible-to-ai-crawlers/): why client-rendered pages are blank to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
- [Crawl budget is a real constraint](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/crawl-budget-is-a-real-constraint/): how enterprise sites waste crawl budget and starve new inventory.
- [Google is ignoring your canonical tags](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/google-is-ignoring-your-canonical-tags/): why a tracking parameter makes Google override your canonicals.
- [Every color and size collapses into one URL — on purpose](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/product-variant-seo/): deciding which product variants earn their own indexable URL.
- [A 10-second LCP is a ranking decision you're making by accident](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/lcp-is-a-ranking-decision/): why third-party tags, not images, wreck Core Web Vitals.

Lifecycle, retention and subscriptions:
- [Your retention rate is lying if you don't cohort it](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/cohort-retention-analysis/): why a blended retention rate hides churn behind new-customer growth.
- [Subscription churn is a pricing problem in disguise](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/subscription-churn-pricing/): splitting involuntary (failed-payment) churn from voluntary price-value churn.
- [Your churn is a payments problem more often than a loyalty problem](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/your-churn-is-a-payments-problem/): involuntary churn and dunning as the cheapest retention win.
- [The unit math that quietly kills subscription businesses](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-unit-math-of-subscriptions/): the cohort and margin math behind subscription viability.

Ecommerce and user journey:
- [Where intent dies: mapping the real path to conversion](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/where-intent-dies/): finding the steps where buyer intent quietly drops off.
- [You can rank on page one and still capture 1% of the market](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/rank-on-page-one-capture-one-percent/): why ranking isn't the same as capturing demand.
- [Grid-first category pages are why a smaller competitor is beating you](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/grid-first-category-pages-are-losing/): why bare product grids lose to content-led category pages.
- [A real lift or just noise? The testing discipline most CRO programs skip](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/a-real-lift-or-just-noise/): distinguishing real experiment lift from noise.

Measurement, incentives and AI (thesis pieces):
- [The AI cheated to inflate its own score. Your ad platform does the same thing.](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-ai-gamed-its-own-scorecard/): Goodhart's law, from an AI gaming its benchmark to platforms gaming their metrics.
- [The AI didn't break free. It was competitive.](https://lindseysobrinski.com/blog/the-ai-didnt-break-free-it-was-competitive/): what the OpenAI–Hugging Face incident says about optimizers and incentives.

## Free tools

- [GEO Site Analyzer](https://lindseysobrinski.com/geo.html): Checks AI-crawler access, structured data, answer-first content, and llms.txt, then scores per-engine readiness.
- [Crawl Budget Waste Checker](https://lindseysobrinski.com/crawl-budget.html): Crawls robots.txt, sitemap, and interior pages to find wasted crawl budget — redirects and dead URLs in the sitemap, noindex pages still being crawled, canonical waste, and parameter sprawl — and quantifies the leak with Search Console numbers.
- [Incrementality Gap Calculator](https://lindseysobrinski.com/roas.html): Estimates the gap between platform-reported ROAS and likely incremental ROAS.
- [AEO/GEO Readiness Scorecard](https://lindseysobrinski.com/scorecard.html): Ten questions on AI-search visibility with a score and a fix-first list.
